##### Functions

```{r function ggplot boxplot}
#####
#make plot function
fn_plot <- function(data, y, y_label, y_breaks =  waiver(), y_trans = "identity", 
                    y_log10 = FALSE, y_limits = c(0, NA), y_expension = .05,
                    facet_expr = NULL, stat = NULL){
  
  p <-  data %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = timepoint, y = {{y}}, col = group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=NA, width =0.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6))+
    geom_line(aes(group = donor), alpha = .5) +
    # geom_quasirandom(method = "quasirandom", width=.4, size=2, alpha = 0.6, varwidth=T, dodge.width=.25, shape = 21, aes(group = factor(donor), col = group, fill = group)) +
  geom_beeswarm(aes(col = group, fill = group), groupOnX = TRUE, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.6, 
                shape = 21, cex = 3, priority = "density"
  ) +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Non-allergic" = "#000000" , "Allergic" = "#D55E00")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Non-allergic" = "#000000" , "Allergic" = "#D55E00")) +    
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    labs(x = NULL, col = "Cohort", x = "Time point", y = y_label)
    
    #facet_wrap
  if (!is.null(facet_expr)) {
    p <- p + facet_expr
  }
    #add p-values
if (!is.null(stat)) {
  p <- p +
    geom_label(
      data = stat,
      aes(
        x = (xmin + xmax) / 2,
        y = y.position,
        label = "p.adj"
          ),
      fill = "white",
      alpha = 0.5,
      color = "white",
      label.size = 0
    ) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
      stat,
      label = "p.adj",
      tip.length = 0.015
    ) 
}
  
    #add custom y scale
  if (y_log10 == TRUE) {
    p <- p + scale_y_continuous(trans = pseudo_log_trans(base = 10), breaks = y_breaks, limits = y_limits, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, y_expension)))
    
    } else {
      
   p <- p + scale_y_continuous(transform = y_trans, breaks = y_breaks, limits = y_limits, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, y_expension)))
    }
        
  #add themes
  p + theme_pubr(legend = "top") + theme_x_angled + theme_fonts + theme_facet + theme_grid + theme(legend.position = "none")
}  


```

```{r function ggplot corr }
#####
#make plot function
fn_plot_cor <- function(data, x, x_label, y, y_label ,y_limits = c(NA, NA), y_breaks = NULL, y_trans = NULL, facet_expr = NULL){
  
  p <-  data %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = {{x}}, y = {{y}}, col = timepoint)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F) +
    stat_cor(method = "spearman", label.y.npc = .98, p.accuracy = 0.001) +
    scale_y_continuous(trans = pseudo_log_trans(base = 10), 
                     breaks = c(0, 1, 10, 100, 1000), limits = y_limits) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("d0" = "#009E73","d7" = "#0072B2" , "mo6" = "#CC79A7")) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    labs(col = "Time point", x = x_label, y = y_label, title = NULL, subtitle = NULL)
    
    #facet_wrap
  if (!is.null(facet_expr)) {
    p <- p + facet_expr
  }
  
      #add custom y breaks
  if (!is.null(y_breaks) && is.null(y_trans)) {
    p <- p + scale_y_continuous(breaks = y_breaks, limits = y_limits)
  } 
  
  if(!is.null(y_trans)){
    if (y_trans == "log10" && is.null(y_breaks)) {
    p <- p + scale_y_continuous(trans = pseudo_log_trans(base = 10), limits = y_limits)
    }
  
    if (y_trans == "log10" && !is.null(y_breaks)) {
    p <- p + scale_y_continuous(trans = pseudo_log_trans(base = 10), breaks = y_breaks, limits = y_limits)
    } 
  }

        
  #add themes
  p + theme_pubr(legend = "top") + theme_x_angled + theme_fonts + theme_facet + theme_grid +
  theme(legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, -10, 0), legend.margin = margin(0, 0, -5, 0))
}  
```

```{r function for corr heatmap}
fn_corr <- function(x, y, timepoint_column = NULL, timepoints = NULL) {
  
  fn <- function(x, y) {
    #Inner function calculate correlation and return Rho, P values, and Stars
    id_col_x <- names(x)[1]
    id_col_y <- names(y)[1]
    #Arrange the ids so that they match, and transform as matrix with ID to row names
    x <- x %>% arrange(id_col_x) %>% column_to_rownames(id_col_x) %>% as.matrix()
    y <- y %>% arrange(id_col_y) %>% column_to_rownames(id_col_y) %>% as.matrix()
    #Create matrixes to store Rho, P, and Stars
    rho <- matrix(
      NA_real_,
      nrow = ncol(x),
      ncol = ncol(y),
      dimnames = list(colnames(x), colnames(y))
    )
    p <- matrix(
      NA_real_,
      nrow = ncol(x),
      ncol = ncol(y),
      dimnames = list(colnames(x), colnames(y))
    )
    stars <- matrix(
      "",
      nrow = ncol(x),
      ncol = ncol(y),
      dimnames = list(colnames(x), colnames(y))
    )
    
    #Compute correlation in two for loops (one to seq through columns, the other one through rows)
    for (i in seq_len(ncol(x))) {
      for (j in seq_len(ncol(y))) {
        idx <- complete.cases(x[, i], y[, j])
        if (sum(idx) >= 3) {
          ct <- cor.test(
            x[idx, i],
            y[idx, j],
            method = "spearman",
            exact = FALSE
          )
          rho[i, j] <- unname(ct$estimate)
          p[i, j] <- ct$p.value
          
          # Assign stars based on p-value
          if (p[i, j] < 0.001) {
            stars[i, j] <- "***"
          } else if (p[i, j] < 0.01) {
            stars[i, j] <- "**"
          } else if (p[i, j] < 0.05) {
            stars[i, j] <- "*"
          } else if (p[i, j] < 0.1) {
            stars[i, j] <- "."
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    list(rho = rho, p = p, stars = stars)
  }
  
  #outer function: Reorder matrices per variable and timepoint: 
  #Var1 Time1-Time2-..., Var2 Time1-Time2-..., ...
  if (is.null(timepoints)) {
    fn(x, y)
    
  } else {
    res <- lapply(timepoints, function(tp) {
      y_tp <- y %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[timepoint_column]] == tp) %>% 
        select(-all_of(timepoint_column))
      fn(x, y_tp)
    })
    names(res) <- timepoints
    
    # Stack results by timepoint first
    rho_combined <- do.call(rbind, lapply(res, function(x) x$rho))
    p_combined <- do.call(rbind, lapply(res, function(x) x$p))
    stars_combined <- do.call(rbind, lapply(res, function(x) x$stars))
    
    # Reorder to group by variable instead of timepoint
    n_timepoints <- length(timepoints)
    n_vars <- nrow(rho_combined) / n_timepoints
    
    t <- rep(1:n_vars, each = n_timepoints) + rep(0:(n_timepoints-1) * n_vars, times = n_vars)
    
    rho_combined <- rho_combined[t, ]
    p_combined <- p_combined[t, ]
    stars_combined <- stars_combined[t, ]
    
    # Create variable and timepoint labels for each row
    variable_labels <- rep(rownames(res[[1]]$rho), each = n_timepoints)
    timepoint_labels <- rep(timepoints, times = n_vars)
    
    # Return results as lists
    list(
      rho = rho_combined,
      p = p_combined,
      stars = stars_combined,
      variable = variable_labels,
      timepoint = timepoint_labels
    )
  }
}
```

```{r preping data}
#Load clinical data
donor <- c("AH02", "H012", "H028", "H112", "H137", "H901", "H902", "H903", "H906", "H907", "H908", "H909", "H910", "H911")

data <- read_xlsx(path = paste0(wd, "data\\in\\IgE_IgG4_SerumELISA.xlsx"), sheet = 3)
data$`sIgG4 (i3 ) [mgA/L] Common wasp venom`
data <- data %>% 
  filter(id %in% donor) %>% 
  mutate(visit = case_when(timepoint %in% c("d0", "d7") ~ "V1", timepoint == c("mo6") ~ "V2"),
         day = case_when(timepoint %in% c("d0", "mo6") ~ "d0", timepoint == "d7" ~ "d7"),
         Cohort = case_when(
           Cohort == "Healthy Controls" ~ "Non-allergic", 
           Cohort == "WaspVenom" ~ "Allergic"),
         Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = c("Non-allergic", "Allergic"))) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(donor = "id",
         group = "Cohort",
         IgG4_Wasp = `sIgG4 (i3 ) [mgA/L] Common wasp venom`,
         IgG4_VesV5 = `sIgG4 (i209 ) [mgA/L]    Ves v 5`,
         IgG4_VesV1 = `sIgG4 (i211 ) [mgA/L]   Ves v 1`,
         IgE_total = `tIgE`,
         IgE_Wasp = `Wasp i3 IgE`,
         IgE_VesV5 = `Ves v 5 IgE`,
         IgE_VesV1 = `Ves v 1 IgE`) %>% 
  mutate(
    timepoint = case_when(
      group == "Non-allergic" ~ "Non-allergic",
      group == "Allergic" & visit == "V1" & day == "d0" ~ "d0",
      group == "Allergic" & visit == "V1" & day == "d7" ~ "d7",
      group == "Allergic" & visit == "V2" ~ "mo6"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("Non-allergic", "d0", "d7", "mo6"))) %>% 
  select(donor, visit, day, timepoint, group, IgE_total, IgE_Wasp, IgE_VesV1, IgE_VesV5, IgG4_Wasp, IgG4_VesV1, IgG4_VesV5) %>% 
  mutate(
    across(IgE_total:IgG4_VesV5, as.numeric),
    IgG4IgE_wasp = 10^(log10(IgG4_Wasp + 1) / log10(IgE_Wasp + 1)),
    IgG4IgE_VesV1 = 10^(log10(IgG4_VesV1 + 1) / log10(IgE_VesV1 + 1)),
    IgG4IgE_VesV5 = 10^(log10(IgG4_VesV5 + 1) / log10(IgE_VesV5 + 1))
    )

#Data from flow cytometer to calculate % of scRNAseq clusters on frequency of total CD4 or CD8

colnames(data_flow)[1] <- "id"

  filter(!donor == "H905") %>%

#T cells scRNAseq
T_Clusters <- read_csv(paste0(wd, "data\\out\\cluster_stat\\cluster_Tcells.csv")) %>%

#Recode clusters names
names <- list(
  `1` = "Treg act low",
  `3` = "Treg act high",
  
  `2` = "Th2 no cytokines",
  `5` = "Th2 classical",
  `9` = "Th2 IL5+ IL3-",
  `7` = "Th2 IL31+",
  `6` = "Th2 Granzyme+",
  
  `10` = "CD4 XCL1+",
  `11` = "CD4 IL2+",
  `4` = "CD4 CCL20+ IL4l1+",
  
  `8` = "CD8 Granzyme+",
  `12` = "low quality cells"
)

#One dataframe for percentage of clusters in unstulated samples
T_Clusters_unstim <- T_Clusters %>% 
  mutate(group = case_when(donor == "Unstim" ~ "Unstim", 
                           donor %in% c("AH02", "H012", "H028", "H112", "H137") ~ "Non-allergic",
                          .default = "Allergic")) %>% 
    mutate(parent_pop = case_when(
    clusters %in% c(2,4,5,6,7,9,10,11) ~ "Tcon",
    clusters %in% c(1,3) ~ "Treg",
    .default = NA
    )) %>% 
  group_by(donor, visit, day, parent_pop) %>% 
  mutate(percent_of_parents = Freq / sum(Freq, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
         percent_of_parents = ifelse(clusters %in% c(8, 12), NA, percent_of_parents)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(clusters_names = recode(clusters, !!!names),
         clusters_names = factor(clusters_names, levels = unlist(names)))
  
# Bind T cells scRNAseq with flow data
T_Clusters <- data_flow %>% 
  filter(stimulation == "Venom") %>% 
  left_join(T_Clusters)



T_Clusters <- T_Clusters %>% 
  mutate(clusters_names = recode(clusters, !!!names),
         clusters_names = factor(clusters_names, levels = unlist(names)))

#Calculate percentage on CD4 or on CD8
T_Clusters <- T_Clusters %>% 
  group_by(donor, visit, day) %>% 
  mutate(
    percent = Freq * 100,
    percent_of_CD4CD8 = case_when(
      clusters %in% c(8) ~ Freq * activated_cd8,
      clusters %in% c(1, 3) ~ Freq * treg_cd4,
      clusters %in% c(2, 4:7, 9:12) ~ Freq * activated_cd4
    )
  ) %>% 
  select(-Freq) %>% 
  ungroup()


#Add percentage normalised to parent population (Tcon clusters with Tcon, Treg with Tregs)
T_clusters_parent <- T_Clusters %>% 
  filter(!clusters %in% c(8, 12)) %>% 
  mutate(parent_pop = case_when(
    clusters %in% c(2,4,5,6,7,9,10,11) ~ "Tcon",
    clusters %in% c(1,3) ~ "Treg",
    .default = NA
    )) %>% 
  group_by(donor, timepoint, parent_pop) %>% 
  mutate(percent_of_parents = percent / sum(percent, na.rm = TRUE) * 100) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(!clusters_names == "Treg act low") #as opposed to Treg act high

#Calculate percentage of Tregs on all WV-specific T cells
treg_df <- T_Clusters %>% 
  select(donor, timepoint, clusters, percent) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = clusters, values_from = percent) %>% 
  mutate(percent_of_parents = `1` + `3`) %>% 
  select(donor, timepoint, percent_of_parents) %>% 
  mutate(clusters_names = "Treg of WV-Tcells")

order <- c("Treg of WV-Tcells", "Treg act high", "Th2 no cytokines", "Th2 classical", "Th2 IL5+ IL3-", "Th2 IL31+", "Th2 Granzyme+", "CD4 XCL1+", "CD4 IL2+", "CD4 CCL20+ IL4l1+")

T_clusters_parent <- T_clusters_parent %>% bind_rows(treg_df) %>% 
  arrange(donor, timepoint, clusters_names) %>% 
  fill(everything(), .direction = "down") %>% 
  mutate(clusters_names = factor(clusters_names, levels = order))
```

```{r donor table}
  # filter(timepoint %in% c("d0", "Non-allergic")) %>%
```

```{r Titers}
#Total IgE
stat.test <- data %>% 
  wilcox_test(IgE_total ~ timepoint, p.adjust.method = "BH", paired = TRUE,
              comparisons = list(c("d0", "d7"), c("d0", "mo6"))) %>% 
  add_xy_position(x = "timepoint", step.increase = 1) %>% 
    mutate(
    p.adj = round(p.adj, 3),
    y.position = y.position * .75)

  add_xy_position(x = "timepoint", step.increase = 1.5) %>%   
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    p.adj = round(p.adj, 3),
    y.position = y.position * .60)
```

```{r Seurat Cluster adt }
ADT_df <-  T_Clusters %>% 
  filter(!clusters %in% c(8,12),
         !timepoint == "Non-allergic"
         ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint))

plot_group <- ADT_df %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c("ADT_CD3", "ADT_Notch2"), names_to = "Protein", values_to = "ADT") %>% 
  fn_plot(y = ADT, 
               y_label = "Protein relative expression", 
               y_expension = .09,
               stat = NULL, 
               facet_expr = facet_grid(rows = vars(Protein), cols = vars(clusters_names), scales = "free", labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 15))
               )

svglite(paste0(filepath_plots, "Tcells_cluster_box_ADT.svg"), width = 15, height = 8)
plot_group
dev.off()

# Notch2 only
stat.test <- ADT_df %>%
  group_by(clusters_names) %>% 
  wilcox_test(ADT_Notch2 ~ timepoint, p.adjust.method = "BH", paired = TRUE,
              comparisons = list(c("d0", "d7"), c("d0", "mo6"))) %>% 
  add_xy_position(x = "timepoint", step.increase = .16, scales  = "fixed") %>% 
  mutate(p.adj = round(p.adj, 3),
         p.adj = ifelse(p.adj < .001, "< .001", p.adj),
         )

plot_group <- ADT_df %>% 
  fn_plot(y = ADT_Notch2, 
               y_label = "Notch 2 protein [relative expression]", 
               y_expension = .1,
               stat = stat.test, 
               facet_expr = facet_wrap(~clusters_names, scales = "fixed", labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 20), nrow=2)
               ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(NA,1.70), breaks = c(.25, .5, .75, 1, 1.25, 1.5))

svglite(paste0(filepath_plots, "Tcells_cluster_box_NOTCH2.svg"), width = 9, height = 6.5)
plot_group
dev.off()
```

##### Gene Expression

```{r Exhaustion }
df_plot <- T_Clusters %>% 
  filter(!clusters %in% c(1,3,8,12), #remove Tregs and clusters 8 and 12 from data
         !timepoint == "Non-allergic"
         ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c("PDCD1", "CTLA4", "LAG3", "TIGIT"), names_to = "Exhaust", values_to = "Expr")
  

svglite(paste0(filepath_plots, "Tcells_cluster_box_Exhaust.svg"), width = 15, height = 7)
df_plot %>% fn_plot(y = Expr, 
               y_label = "Gene expression", 
               y_expension = .09,
               stat = NULL, 
               facet_expr = facet_grid(rows = vars(Exhaust), cols = vars(clusters_names), scales = "free", labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 20))
               )
dev.off()

#scale and calculate exhaustion score
df_plot_exhaust <- df_plot %>% 
  group_by(Exhaust) %>% 
  mutate(Expr = (Expr - min(Expr, na.rm = TRUE)) / (max(Expr, na.rm = TRUE) - min(Expr, na.rm = TRUE)) ) %>% 
  group_by(donor, timepoint, clusters_names) %>% 
  mutate(Exhaust_score = mean(Expr)) %>% 
  ungroup()
  
# Verify than scalling worked
df_plot_exhaust %>% fn_plot(y = Expr, 
               y_label = "Gene expression", 
               y_expension = .09,
               stat = NULL, 
               facet_expr = facet_grid(rows = vars(Exhaust), cols = vars(clusters_names), scales = "free", labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 12))
               )

stat.test <- df_plot_exhaust %>%
  group_by(clusters_names) %>% 
  wilcox_test(Exhaust_score ~ timepoint, p.adjust.method = "BH", paired = TRUE,
              comparisons = list(c("d0", "d7"), c("d0", "mo6"))) %>% 
  add_xy_position(x = "timepoint", step.increase = .15, scales  = "fixed") %>% 
  mutate(
    p.adj = round(p.adj, 3),
    p.adj = ifelse(p.adj < .001, "< .001", p.adj)
    )

svglite(paste0(filepath_plots, "Tcells_cluster_box_Exhaust_score.svg"), width = 9, height = 6.5)
df_plot_exhaust %>% select(donor, timepoint, group, Exhaust_score,clusters_names) %>% distinct() %>% 
  fn_plot(y = Exhaust_score, 
               y_label = "Exhaustion score", 
               y_expension = .08,
               facet_expr = facet_wrap(~clusters_names, scales = "fixed", nrow = 2,labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 20)),
               stat = stat.test)
dev.off()
```
